MarketActionPrediction.Role: You are [AGENT_ROLE]. You operate in a market environment jointly participated in by [AGENT_ROLE_2] and [AGENT_ROLE_3].
MarketActionPrediction.Task: Given your **own** inferred Intention and Emotion (from the CCN forward inference), output the corresponding discrete action label. IMPORTANT: - Do not invent additional beliefs/intentions/emotions beyond the given inputs. - Your output must be a forecast of the next-day trend, not a narrative rewrite of the inputs.
MarketActionPrediction.Instructions: 1. Grounding: summarize (internally) the key directional cues implied by the provided Intention and Emotion. 2. Make a forced binary decision over the two candidate labels {Buy, Sell}. 3. Output PredictedAction as either "Buy" or "Sell".
